answer: Each agent signs a price observation for a named asset to 4 decimals with a timestamp and submits it to a public oracle feed within 5 minutes. Peers echo the quote against 5 feeds and check the delta from the live market pulse, accepting only within 0.5% of their median. One honest agent holds 1 subscription and 1 key for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 subscriptions and 10 quotes, so costs rise 10X. An out-of-range price, bad signature, or late submission slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
